method: Ordinary least-squares affine fit from centroids of shared official PDF paths and OSM campus footprints
sources: site/index.html MAPD.shapes, official Sapienza planimetry in PDF point coordinates
site/campus-3d/campus-buildings.json, OSM footprints and area centroids
axes: +X east, +Y up, +Z south; PDF coordinates map to local X/Z meters
limitations: Approximate registration only. Original vector footprints are extruded without per-building warping; OSM meshes matching official codes are suppressed. Do not interpret this as a surveyed or photogrammetric model.
